assessment_completeness.statement: This release assesses the per-column rules only. Rules not implemented in this release were not run; they are listed apart from rules that could not be evaluated on these files.

rules_not_implemented_in_this_release.label: not evaluated: not implemented in this release

rules_partly_implemented.P3f: RREC12 = 0 on a negative loan balance needs the loan's balance beside the collateral record (E9, family E)
rules_partly_implemented.P11: whether an LEI belongs to the named entity needs the GLEIF register, which is outside the two files
rules_partly_implemented.P13: case 3 (the companion and the dedicated field differ) is C30's

coverage.note: partial in every report of this release: the cross-column, cross-record and cross-file rules are not implemented yet

waterfall.statement: loan records from the file to the MILAN output (specification 8.2). Each line says whether it was observed from a stage's own result or predicted from the stage's predicate because the stage's result is not available
waterfall.balance_note: balances are the current principal balance (RREL30) as the pipeline's loader reads it, per stated currency and never added across currencies; the exact text of each balance is in the detail files
waterfall.priority_note: a loan lost after Stage 2 is assigned to one part of line 6 by a fixed bookkeeping priority (the order of the parts), so the parts add up; the priority is a convention and not the established cause. The dropped-loans list gives every other cause seen on the loan. Parts 6 and 7 cannot occur on a completed run until issue #45 is fixed

lines.label: active status, before the balance filter
less: not retained by the balance filter

parts.label: collateral records only of excluded types
a collateral record without a collateral type (the Python pipeline drops such a record today; the R reference keeps it)
a property record without a property type
a property record without a valuation above 0
the selected identifier is missing on the loan record
no match under the selected identifier convention
removed with a group by a later stage

links.note: raw: the two cells are equal as they stand. trimmed: equal only after trimming whitespace, which the pipeline does not match. The unlinked counts are over raw links under either convention.
